title: Reference-ET ptra to Restricted Root-Uptake Execution Composition
goal: Compose the canonical F-CI29 authoritative potential-transpiration binding with the already qualified shared crop/root adapter and restricted committed root-water-uptake execution path, without adding ET physics, crop physics, persistent state, accepted-window integration, or mass-ledger booking.
composition: validate and bind authoritative ptra with fmr_bind_reference_et_ptra_to_root_input
pass the bound canonical crop_root_uptake_input_t to fmr_evaluate_shared_crop_root_uptake
return existing nodewise root_extraction_sink, actual_uptake_total, child diagnostics and explicit composition diagnostics
on any upstream rejection return fail-closed zero/default outputs and do not call the downstream execution stage
transaction_contract: read committed hydraulic state only; no revision change, no committed mutation, no persistent composition state
mass_contract: root uptake flux result is a process result only in F-MR28; no authoritative water-ledger booking and no accepted-window integration are introduced
time_contract: no new clock or day semantics; potential-transpiration rate semantics and committed-state evaluation are inherited from the admitted owners
hard_nonclaims: no interval integration or exactly-once accepted booking
no oxygen, salinity, frost, compensation, MICRO/Jong-van-Lier or macropore uptake expansion
tests: single new production-source delta from exact canonical base
active composition bitwise-equals explicit F-CI29 then F-MR12/F-MR10 chain
incoming stale ptra cannot affect root uptake
upstream ET rejection prevents root execution
invalid root geometry prevents root execution
inactive crop zero route remains fail-safe
committed revision and physical snapshot remain unchanged
